name: Mesu Iki Namahousou ~Ano Ko ga Erokute Totsurimashita~
original_name: 牝イキ生放送 ～あの娘がエロくて凸りました～
source:
Keisuke Oshida, who had become a recluse due to bullying, spent his days doing nothing but surfing the Internet, but one chance led him to meet a "princess" who makes live broadcasts.
He was astonished by a world he had never known before, and he began to wish to meet the "Hime" himself.

Keisuke succeeded in finding out where she lived from her broadcasts and SNS posts, so he decides to visit the princess during a broadcast...

[Translated from [url=https://store-jp.nintendo.com/list/software/70010000057104.html]Nintendo Store (JP)[/url]]
translation:
绪田圭介因遭受欺凌而闭门不出，每天只会上网消磨时间；一次偶然的机会，他遇见了一名进行直播的“公主”。他对从未见过的世界感到震惊，开始渴望亲自见到“姬”。

圭介通过她的直播和社交网络帖子查到了她的住址，于是决定在直播期间拜访这位公主……

（译自[url=https://store-jp.nintendo.com/list/software/70010000057104.html]任天堂商店（日）[/url]）
